tldr: Tencent put the Hy4 flash weights out for anyone to download, a very large model that only runs a small part of itself per word. Coding agents now write code faster than teams can review it, according to a Harvard study. Malicious releases of Microsoft's agent framework on PyPI carried a credential stealer. Workday agreed to buy Honeydew, and OpenAI signed a deal with Le Figaro. Anthropic prices its IPO in New York tonight.

articles.title: Tencent releases Hy4 flash as open weights with a 1M context
articles.summary: 224B MoE with 12B active per token, 1M context, native text and image. Hosted at $0.070 per million input tokens.

articles.title: Harvard: coding agents moved the bottleneck to code review
articles.summary: Agents add code faster than teams can review it, so review time now grows faster than shipping output.

articles.title: Microsoft's agent framework on PyPI shipped a credential stealer
articles.summary: Releases of the Python package loaded a stealer through .pth import hooks, so the code ran on import without a call.

articles.title: OpenAI brings Le Figaro journalism into ChatGPT
articles.summary: Summaries and excerpts from Le Figaro inside ChatGPT, with links back to the original stories.

articles.title: Cognition launches Devin Bots that lead teams of Devins
articles.summary: Goal-owning agents that plan the work and coordinate a team of Devin workers instead of one agent doing every step.

articles.title: Workday to buy Honeydew for its semantic layer
articles.summary: The semantic layer compiles business logic into queries before the model sees them, aimed at tighter HR and finance answers.

articles.title: Suno adds visuals so its songs come with matching video
articles.summary: A new Visuals feature generates images and video clips to go with generated tracks, inside the same product.

articles.title: Why Gemini 4 Carbon has taken so long
articles.summary: A technical post on the delay to Google's next flagship model and the size of the training runs behind it.

articles.title: Ropedia Xperience 2 aims to standardise physical AI testing
articles.summary: A paper plus environment suite for scaling physical AI training and behaviour, aimed at reproducible robot benchmarks.
